headlines.text: 2025 brought us this moment: gold changed shoulders as the AEW World Tag Team Titles found a new champion as Brodido vs. The Hurt Syndicate vs. FTR battled it out, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 6.71 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Brodido was challenging for gold for the very first time. Brodido stole a pinfall amid the chaos of a three-way, catching FTR off guard just as The Hurt Syndicate closed in to steal the win, crowning new AEW World Tag Team Champions.

That Wednesday in 2022, United Empire vs. Death Triangle met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.56 ? a match fans still talk about. A returning Kip Sabian's ringside interference on PAC proved decisive, letting Aussie Open finish off Rey Fenix and send United Empire through to face The Elite in the semifinals.
Flash back to 2024, when Top Flight & Rush didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team in a Ladder match, appearing on Collision, rated 6.89.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when Adam Page vs. MJF fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 8.06 ? a genuinely great match. With a stipulation that a DQ or countout would cost him the belt, Page fought off MJF's every trick to retain the AEW World Championship.

Turning the clock back to 2025: Zack Sabre Jr. vs. Nigel McGuinness clashed for the IWGP World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 8.06 ? a real highlight of the night. For Nigel McGuinness, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Sabre wrestled a clean technical showcase against McGuinness, retaining the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship in front of a hometown UK crowd.

Flash back to 2025, when Mercedes Mone vs. Alex Windsor vs. Bozilla vs. Persephone went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.08 ? a well-worked match. For Bozilla and Persephone, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Mercedes Mone was chasing gold for the 20th time. Mon? retained the TBS Championship in a four-way standout performance from newcomer Bozilla, ultimately catching Persephone in a hurricanrana for the pin.
